d: Indonesia is facing a political storm. Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has reportedly told President Prabowo Subianto that he intends to resign, while questions over his eligibility for office continue to mount. At the same time, a wiretapping scandal involving senior police officials is raising questions about tensions within the ruling establishment. Add falling approval ratings, student protests, economic concerns and devastating wildfires, and Prabowo faces pressure on multiple fronts. Is the political alliance that brought him to power beginning to fall apart?
